Hi Alice — great question and thanks for the clear list. Recap and answers below (high level) + next steps. I've attached a small redwood-audit-sample.csv and a short evidence guide.

Post-call recap / answers:
- Audit surface: we record request-level and admin actions. Typical fields: timestamp (UTC), request_id, api_key_owner (or service account), user_id (if provided), model, endpoint/route, action (generate, embed, export), ip_address, response_size, cached (bool), storage_bucket (if export), and admin_console_user for console actions.
- Export formats: CSV and JSON are available immediately; Parquet exports are available for Dedicated/Private customers via our export job.
- Retention: default hosted retention for request/audit logs is 90 days for self-serve accounts. For enterprise (Dedicated/Private) we support configurable retention; common SLAs include 365 days (standard) and up to 7 years on request with a contractual addendum.
- PII handling: logs capture user-provided identifiers if customers pass them. We provide two options: (1) include full request payloads in logs (default for debugging) or (2) redact request bodies and only retain metadata in exports. Redaction can be configured at the account or route level; we can also run a one-time export with PII fields removed.
- Data residency: for Dedicated/Private customers we can keep logs in-region (US/EU/APAC). Hosted logs are stored in our primary region for the account and we provide region selections on enterprise plans.
- Evidence: attached is a small sample CSV and a short guide describing fields and export options. For auditors we can provide an attestation describing RBAC, encryption, and retention policies.

Next steps / timeline:
1) Please confirm the compliance contact and preferred secure transfer method (SFTP with client key, secure Drive share, or guarded S3 presigned URL).
2) We'll prepare a redacted sample export and an evidence package (attestation + schema) — estimated delivery: 2 business days after transfer method is confirmed.
3) If you need a longer retention or custom export format, I'll loop in our Product/Security (CC'd Neha) for a fast-track quote — estimate 3-5 business days for setup.

Attachments: redwood-audit-sample.csv, redwood-audit-evidence-guide.pdf

If helpful I can include a short mapping file to clarify which CSV columns map to audit controls your auditors typically look for.

Best,

Hi Alice — quick answers inline and next actions. Looping in Neha (Security) and Marissa (Customer Success) for the evidence handoff.

- Can request payloads be excluded? Yes. We support an export mode that omits request bodies and any PII fields. For hosted customers we can run a one-off export; for enterprise we can configure automated exports with PII redaction. We'll provide a redact-schema for your reviewers.

- Admin console activity: yes — every console action is recorded with a timestamp and the SSO-mapped user identity (email). Exports include the admin_console_user column and the object changed. We can correlate console events to audit log request IDs.

- Training/data usage: Redwood does not train models on customer data. We have a public policy and can provide a signed attestation for your auditors. See link below.

Transfer & timeline: provide your SFTP details (host, path, public key) or accept a guarded Drive link. Once we have a transfer method we'll:
  - deliver a redacted CSV sample + field mapping (1 business day)
  - provide the attestation + evidence guide (1-2 business days)

Neha — can you prepare the signed attestation and a sample console-export (admin events) we can send to FinCo?

Alice — if you prefer, we can also set up a 30-minute call this week to walk your auditors through the sample export.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
